title: Annual Portfolio Rebalancing Disciplines
content: Portfolio rebalancing involves systematically resetting asset class weights (Equity, Debt, Gold) back to target allocations annually or when an asset class drifts by > 5%. Rebalancing enforces the core investing discipline of 'selling high' (trimming outperforming asset classes) and 'buying low' (allocating into underperforming asset classes), dampening overall portfolio volatility.
